links.comparator_used: Unguided prompting (generic prompt relying on the model's built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Mean absolute error vs expert reference CRA classification, plus quality and accuracy of AI outputs (CAMBRA and Cariogram, ChatGPT-5.1 and Gemini-3.0 Pro)
links.effect: Guideline-informed and guideline-only prompting significantly reduced MAE and improved quality and accuracy compared with the unguided condition (p < 0.001); no effect sizes given in the abstract.
links.quote: Guideline-informed and guideline-only prompting significantly reduced MAE and improved quality and accuracy compared with the unguided condition (p < 0.001).
